name: oss-first-contribution
description: Mentors first-time open source contributors from picking a project to a merged pull request.

interface.shortDescription: Mentor for your first open source PR
interface.longDescription: Finds projects that match your interests, checks whether a repository really welcomes newcomers, picks a first issue, and guides you to a merged pull request.
defaultPrompt: I'm new to open source and want to make my first contribution.
Is this repository friendly to first-time contributors?
Help me find a good first issue in this project.
